notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station and all creatures.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
